about.what: Every reasoning result the paper can draw on, each tied to a named checkpoint, its parent, its protocol and its source records.
rules: A result comes from one source record, named in its `source` field.
A change is a checkpoint minus the checkpoint it was trained from, under one protocol, over the same tasks on both sides.
A pairing with the wrong parent, a missing task or mixed protocols is not computed. It is listed in `rejected_changes` with the reason.
out_of_scope: Protocol B values that exist only as numbers copied by hand (data/protocol_b.py).

protocol_a_comma_records.what: The front-loaded Comma arm (comma-mv_reasoning), in the same format and on the same questions as protocol_a_records

protocol_a_older_records.what: The older experiments' checkpoints (100B mixture ablation, non-decontaminated MV, 0.4B comparison), in the same format and on the same questions as protocol_a_records

protocol_a_fineweb_april_records.what: The April FineWeb-Edu 16K base, in the same format and on the same questions as protocol_a_records. It replaces that file's August 16K model in Phase 1 and the front-loading study

protocol_a_dclm_16k_records.what: The DCLM 16K checkpoints (base, Tulu3 SFT and DPO), in the same format and on the same questions as protocol_a_records, with their strict IFEval verdicts and their LiveCodeBench v5 verdicts. They join Phase 1

protocol_a_ifeval_strict.what: Protocol A IFEval verdicts with the strict checker, in the same format and on the same instructions as protocol_a_records. Every Protocol A IFEval result is computed from them, in place of the record files' loose verdicts

protocol_a_lcb_v5.what: Protocol A LiveCodeBench v5 verdicts, in the same format as protocol_a_records, on the 369 problems Protocol B runs. Every Protocol A LiveCodeBench result is computed from them, in place of the record files' LiveCodeBench v2 verdicts

protocol_a_masked_records.what: The four masked MV checkpoints of Table 15, in the same format and on the same questions as protocol_a_records. The records name copies of the laion masked models with the same weights, and the results are keyed by the laion repos, with the records' name in their source

files.eval_responses.parquet: columns base_model, stage, task, example_idx, run_idx, example_id, is_correct, source_dir, source_file, decoding, max_tokens

phase2_records.rows: decoding == sampling (and num_repeat == 3 in eval_scores). IFEval: metric == inst-level,strict

checkpoint_snapshot.what: Hugging Face model records: repos, weight hashes, model cards, training summaries and context settings

older_evaluations.what: lm-eval-harness results files of the older evaluations, January to May 2026, which no table of the paper prints any more

language_logs.what: Harsh Raj's language runs of May 2026, three prompt-example seeds, of which the `default` folder is read

language_results.what: Harsh Raj's language results files of 2026-10-16, one seed

language_masked.what: Language results files of the masked checkpoints, run on 2026-10-12

language_settings.what: The shot count and metric of each language task

protocol_a.used_for: Phase 1, the front-loading study, the older experiments and masking
protocol_a.settings: the paper's Protocol A table (appendix, evaluation settings)

JEEBench.metric: score with partial credit (0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 or 1 per question)

IFEval.metric: instruction-level accuracy, strict, over the 500-prompt subset

phase2_three_seed.used_for: Phase 2 (OT30K and the other reasoning datasets), and the removal of OpenThoughts3 from pretraining
phase2_three_seed.settings: marianna13's note of 2026-10-07 and the records' max_tokens column

older_evalchemy.used_for: Tables 7, 8, 9 and 15: the 100B mixture ablation, decontamination, the 0.4B comparison and masking
older_evalchemy.decoding: the older evaluation setup, one run per evaluation
older_evalchemy.scoring: lm-eval-harness accuracy_avg (accuracy for MATH500), GSM8K with the flexible-extract parser, HumanEval as the mean of its Python and shell scores, IFEval as the mean of its prompt-level and instruction-level scores
